findings.heading: Compile by name / Compilar por nombre
findings.proposition: The date- and time-stamped output sub-folder is specific to the report being compiled.
findings.reader_consequence: The Spanish reads 'una subcarpeta con fecha y hora especificas', which attaches 'specific' to the date and time instead of to the report. A Spanish reader does not learn that each report gets its own sub-folder under 'outputs', so they expect all reports of one compile run to land together and may look in the wrong place for a given report's output.

findings.heading: New factory / Nueva fabrica
findings.proposition: The gitignore bullet points the reader to the 'Version control and collaboration with Github' chapter as a follow-up reference.
findings.reader_consequence: The Spanish keeps the bracketed chapter title but has no link destination at all, so it renders as literal bracketed text rather than a cross-reference. A Spanish reader cannot follow the pointer to the version-control chapter and gets an unexplained '[...]' in the middle of the bullet.

findings.heading: Scripts
findings.proposition: The .R scripts stored in the 'scripts' folder are sourced BY the .Rmd scripts.
findings.reader_consequence: The Spanish says the .R scripts 'se originan en tus scripts .Rmd' (originate in your .Rmd scripts), reversing the direction of the dependency. A Spanish reader may think the 'scripts' folder holds code extracted out of the Rmd files, rather than shared code the Rmd files call with source(), and so will not set up the sourcing pattern the chapter recommends.
